# MoA+
**Advancing intelligence through agent collaboration.**
MoA+ is a **Mixture of Agents collaboration plugin for DeepSeek Harness**. It connects persistent ag
ents through independent contexts, direct communication, and shared knowledge, with the goal of expa
nding what the whole system can accomplish together.
A Coordinator keeps the goal and overall direction in view. Workers investigate, build, challenge, a
nd review in their own conversations, remaining available for the next assignment. The team can expl
ore different approaches, work in parallel, and carry its findings into later tasks.

## Quick start
Requires **Node 24.9+**, npm, and Git. The runtime on `main` needs the matching **DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 com
patibility runtime**: its explicit manifest extends **13 native packages across 31 file paths**. Sto
ck rc.3 and runtimes prepared from another plugin revision cannot be substituted.
Clone the project and prepare a separate Web runtime:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The compatibility command backs up the changed files before extending this checkout's dependencies.
Setup prepares an isolated runtime with its own home, configuration, documents, and native backups;
it leaves your personal Desktop app and `~/.dsh` profile untouched. Use an empty directory outside t
he checkout and reuse the same `--dir` for subsequent commands.
Configure the model in native settings, create a conversation, and select **MoA+** before its first
message. Mode identity stays fixed after starting. Use a Git workspace for isolated Workers; choose
`shared` when they should work directly in the parent's directory. The [first-run guide][quickstart]
covers model setup, `doctor`, and recovery; [compatibility][compatibility] covers manual setup and
odel setup, `doctor`, and recovery; [compatibility][compatibility] covers manual setup and rollback.
For the earlier published Project Mode, follow the v0.1.23 installation instructions. That tag uses
the Project label and the earlier three-extension runtime.
## How it works
### Independent work, direct communication
Coordinator and Workers use the same native Agent Loop, with different identities, tools, and delega
ted permissions. `Task` starts a specialist with a fresh context; `Fork` branches selected committed
history. Independent Git worktrees separate parallel changes, while an explicit shared workspace le
ts Workers use the parent's directory.
`SendMessage` lets agents notify peers, steer work, queue instructions, or ask a blocking question t
hat waits for an explicit reply. `QueryAgent` inspects state and selected history, or waits for prog
ress. `KillAgent` stops execution and waits for resources to exit. Slow tools can run in the backgro
und and return their results automatically.
When a Worker turn finishes, its **complete final AI message** returns automatically to its designat
ed reporting Agent. The Coordinator can review the result, continue with that Worker, or change dire
ction. Retained conversations and workspaces let the team continue across assignments.
### Shared knowledge, independent review
The Coordinator maintains `notes.md` and `archived.md`; the Host refreshes full notes before each Co
ordinator inference. Coordinator and Workers contribute reusable findings through `context/index.md`
, then read relevant files as needed. Isolated Workers access the same shared knowledge, so later wo
rk can build on confirmed findings without copying every execution detail into the main conversation

A Rubric Builder derives acceptance criteria from the original requirements and specification. An Ou
tcome Verifier checks actual deliverables with native tools and returns concrete gaps when results a
re incomplete or evidence is missing. See [roles and common flows][roles], the [code architecture][a
rchitecture], and the [Tool API][tools] for the full contracts.
## See it in action
MoA+ keeps collaboration in the native DSH interface. **Capsules are child conversations**: click on
e to open its Worker, or find the same Worker beneath the Coordinator in the sidebar. You can give t
he Worker instructions directly and use Back to return to the Coordinator. Capsules stay with the tu
rn or message segment where the Worker participated.
Agent messages show their sender and expand from an original-text preview to full Markdown. The clos
able Workers and notes.md tabs show inputs, final replies, artifacts, and current work records. New
user input remains responsive while the team works.
Recorded on **v0.1.23** with the original Project label, this 60-second edit follows a real CLI task
: Exporter changes title sorting, a human adjusts the accepted order inside its conversation, Docs a
ligns the guide, and the Coordinator reviews the result. The next task reuses the Workers and agreed
context. Waits are omitted and labeled. View the artifacts, reproduce the demo, or read [current-ru
ntime verification][verification].
